prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production-ready isolated environment sprite on a truly transparent background, for a fixed-camera 2.5D painted exploration RPG. A single monumental ancient mineralized living carapace shoulder, viewed from the south at 32 degrees downward, no perspective exaggeration, 3:2 landscape. Wide low root footprint and an asymmetric sweeping crest, overall width 1.9 times height. It is a NATURAL geological body, not architecture: several thick irregular crescent plates have grown into one another, one end buried and feathered into a low wide mineral root, the other broken open exposing nested ribs and a deep shadowed cleft. The top silhouette has a decisive off-center high crest, two uneven notches and one lower sloping shoulder. Layers vary in direction, length and thickness; absolutely no staircase, parallel ramps, regular stacked bars, cube, simple polygonal boulder or faceted pyramid. Rich, authored secondary shapes: a few torn plate lips, compression folds and chipped roots that visibly belong to this same body. Broad planes stay calm. Art style: finished hand-painted gouache game asset with crisp readable silhouette and carefully designed three-tone form shading, selective brush strokes and drawn seams; the sophistication of an illustrated RPG environment, no photographic/grunge rock texture and no blurry noise. Palette warm iron-ochre and dark muted umber exposed upper planes, slate purple recessed planes, small muted bone-ochre edge accents, deep plum contact creases. Weighty color, readable at small game size; not pale white and not black. Light from upper left/front, cast shadow localized inside the body and at its very root. No scenery, no sky, no distant landscape, no characters, no grass, no glowing crystals, no text, no border, no checkerboard. Preserve actual alpha outside the organic silhouette. Small root fragments only directly joined to the main root. This sprite will be depth-sorted with a moving 2D character over real 3D terrain; show the complete object with generous transparent margin, especially below its ground contact.
postprocessing: none; preserve alpha; runtime alpha coverage and UV bounds
